title: Bunche Hall floor 10 (tower)

source.what: International Institute 10th floor map of Bunche Hall (CAD plan with room numbers and occupants, March 2006)

notes: The tower floors (3 to 11) share this footprint; only floor 10 is drawn from this plan.
Room numbers come from the plan's labels; the occupant names (2006) are not kept.
The east wall is drawn with cyan window dashes over the black wall line; a cut along it seals the gaps the color filter leaves.

The tower footprint is symmetric end to end, so the outline fit alone can't tell which way round the plan goes; the orientation is set so UCLA's restroom records for the tower (x253, x257, x350 on floors 3, 4 and 8, which stack) fall in the plan's restrooms next to the elevator core.
Stray OCR readings from leader lines and the title (9820T, 1D2, 1028, 286, 27D) are cleared by hand; those rooms keep no number.
